method.touches_open_pr: Each PR's own diff (git diff --name-only <base>...<head>) intersected with the files the fix edits (edit_files: finding files minus evidence-only citations). Stack PRs use their stack parent as base, so an upper PR is not credited with lower PRs' files. #832 is an issue; its fix lives on the local branch fix/speckit-pro-sweep-keeps-running (not pushed), diffed against origin/fix/speckit-pro-deferral-resolution, which it builds on. '#839' names the stop-policy stack #837, #838, #843-#852; after_839 means the fix edits a file that stack or the #832 branch changes.
method.severity: Lane severity after seam-review severity_corrections; a merged duplicate takes the highest member severity; an issue's priority is the highest finding severity inside it.
method.duplicates: Each seam-review duplicate group is filed in one issue with all ids listed.
method.host_parity: Per owner direction, Claude/Codex content-drift findings are absorbed into single-source-host-parity; drift_kept_separate lists the exceptions and why.

invalid.reason: AGENTS.md:63-65 calls Jev optional for agents working on this repository and forbids checks from depending on it. It says nothing about the plugin's runtime dependency. The Codex manifest has no dependency mechanism, and speckit-pro/README.md:122-126 plus codex-skills/speckit-install/SKILL.md:212-215 and speckit-upgrade/SKILL.md:266-269 tell Codex users to add typesafe-jev. No contradiction remains.
